prior_importants.description: The compiled worker settings now always set CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE. That overrides the values an operator pins for workers with `pup init --session-env`, a feature decision 106 added for exactly these two names. The override is silent, and ADR 0152 does not mention decision 106.

findings.description: The test 'keeps the pin when --session-env names its variables' cannot fail on the regression it names. Nothing in src/core reads the recorded session-env names, and the test never puts different CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL / _FORCE values in process.env. A change that let the shell win would still pass in CI and in a pup worker. Add `vi.stubEnv('CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL', 'claude-sonnet-5-5'); vi.stubEnv('CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE', '0');` before compiling.

A worker launched with a code graph now gets two rules for the same question. `## Searching` says to ask Explore for any where-is or how-does question. The `## Code graph` section after it says to use codegraph_explore before reading files. The Explore subagent is limited to Read, Grep and Glob, so it never uses the graph. One sentence on which comes first would settle it.

The added sentence "A worker's settings pin its model and effort, so its rule names neither (decision 152)" repeats the SESSION_SEARCHING JSDoc. It also sits in the decision 41/101/118 git-confinement comment, which it has nothing to do with. Drop it.

The ADR's Tests paragraph says a worker's `env` "is `SLIM_CONTEXT_ENV` plus the three pin variables". No test asserts that exact set: the worker env assertions now use toMatchObject, so an extra key would pass. Either say "contains the three pin variables" or restore an exact toEqual.

The full `## Searching` kickoff literal is asserted word for word here and in profile-compiler-context.test.ts:1715, so every wording change has to be made in both. Keep the full text in the context test only. Here, check `## Searching\n` plus the no-`## Exploring code`, no-`model: "sonnet"` and budget assertions.

The worker pin's three literals (claude-haiku-5-5, '1', 'low') are asserted here and again in the new describe block in profile-compiler.test.ts:638-647, so changing WORKER_SUBAGENT_ROUTE means editing both. Keep the pin test in one place.
